three_wheel_skeleton_architecture.description: Native 3-wheeled vehicle rig: Front single wheel (FL_*) is mounted on the longitudinal centerline Y = 0.0; Rear left (BL_*) and Rear right (BR_*) wheels are at Y = +/-32.5179. There are no FR_* bones in RefSkeleton.

后桥双轮独立悬挂减震器与传动半轴 (Rear Left/Right Suspension & Axles)
三轮刹车盘与卡钳总成（前单轮 + 后双轮） (Three-Wheel Brake Discs & Calipers)
